item.title: BOOM! Buster
item.description:
Title: BOOM! Buster
Genre: Action , Casual , Indie , Strategy
Developer: TALLGLASS
Publisher: TALLGLASS
Franchise: BOOM! Buster
Release Date: Nov 13, 2026




About This Game

A modern arcade game ? Okay, that's pretty cool , actually.

Silky-smooth animation, a bangin' soundtrack, and addictive platformer gameplay, all while carrying live bombs over your head. BOOM! Buster goes the extra mile to evolve the arcade genre into something entirely new.

STORY

Boom! Buster takes place in a video game mirror of New York City. The Wizard has come out of retirement to take over New York by building his big bad "Wizard Towers". What? Wrecking crew Buster and Bridget must tear them down in order to save the city.

GAMEPLAY

WARNING: This game is SUPER hard, broh. And you MAY start to cry while playing it. Wahh! Wahh! That's you. Alright, haha, that was a bit too far, sorry.

Bridget will drop BOMs periodically. If you don't sort them in time... BOOM! It'll all blow up in your face, killing you and your girlfriend on the spot.

You'll need to survive some tricky platforming along with the Wizard's minions and boss-fights through single screens of arcade chaos to save the city.

CONTENT

Addictive , re-playable high-score chasing gameplay, with a collectible food in each level

2 Playable Characters each with their own unique animations, physics, and voice-lines

60 single-screen rounds across:

  • Main Campaign

  • Bonus Rounds putting your wrecking crew skill-set to the test

  • B-side Variants of pre-existing levels from the Main Campaign

  • Boss-Fights with the "Ultimate Almighty Angry Super Wizard" (?)

Local Co-Op Mode

Friggin' Funny Cutscenes

Silky Smooth Hand-Drawn Animation

Full Soundtrack

Think you can beat your high-score?

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Cartoon depictions of blood and guts and sometimes a naughty swear word!



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel or AMD Dual Core CPU
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

item.title: Dice Hoarder
item.description:
Title: Dice Hoarder
Genre: Casual , Indie
Developer: DieCorp Games
Publisher: DieCorp Games
Release Date: Nov 13, 2026




About This Game

You are the perfect fit for the job!

You've been hired to stock a mysterious dice shop. Pick them up, examine their colours and materials, and rebuild 400+ seven-piece dice sets. Each set needs one of every classic polyhedral die: a percentile die, D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, and D20.

Take All the Time You Need

There are no timers and no need to rush. In Story Mode, the next day begins only after you have stocked the required value of dice. Search every corner, plan your sets, and work at your own pace while a cozy ambience and relaxing original soundtrack accompany every shift.

Unlock New Skills

As the days pass, mysterious floppy disks begin to appear. Use them to unlock strange new powers that make your work easier. Track down the remaining dice needed to complete a set, or pull them directly into your hand as if by magic.

The disks are certainly useful. Who keeps leaving them for you is another question...

Who Hired You?

You were given a job, a shop full of scattered dice, and very little information about your employer. Keep completing your shifts, follow the clues left behind, and uncover the truth behind your unusual new workplace.

Key Features

  • Cozy first-person organizing gameplay.

  • Pick up and stock thousands of colorful dice.

  • ASMR, satisfying click-clack dice sounds.

  • Story Mode with shift-based progression and no timers.

  • Mysterious floppy disks that unlock special sorting abilities.

  • Uncover the mystery and the secrets behind the shop.

  • Chill Mode for one uninterrupted, story-free organizing experience.

  • Magical dice, cozy ambience, a relaxing original soundtrack, and a cat.

item.title: We March as One
item.description:
Title: We March as One
Genre: Indie , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: dux
Publisher: dux
Release Date: Nov 13, 2026




About This Game

We March as One is an incremental-style auto battler about building a massive army of shapes with mutliple ways to play:

  • Campaign - Build your army battle by battle

  • Tactics - Fixed army puzzles where placement and orders are everything

  • Command - Real-time orders and battlefield abilities

  • Muster - Fixed budget puzzles where you choose the army

  • Sandbox - Build custom levels and armies

Paint Your Army

  • Paint your troops directly onto the battlefield however you like

  • Tactically position them to counter the enemy force

Command Your Troops

  • Order your troops before the battle starts to plan out your tactics

  • Issue a MARCH command to set up a flank on the enemy or a HOLD command to play more defensively

Upgrade Your Units

  • Earn gold from defeated enemies, whether you win or lose the battle

  • Recruit more troops, unlock new unit types from a branching skill tree, and return with a stronger army

  • Fallen troops return for the next battle, so you keep the army you’ve built

Massive Battles

  • Every soldier and projectile is individually simulated

  • 2D, 3D, or fly-through modes give you multiple ways to view the action

Sandbox Mode

  • Full level editor where you can build and save custom maps

  • Experiment with large unit counts and unusual army compositions across different battlefield layouts

  • Unlock troops and upgrades in the sandbox by encountering them in the other game modes

item.title: Water TD
item.description:
Title: Water TD
Genre: Indie , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Managagrau
Publisher: Managagrau
Release Date: Nov 13, 2026




About This Game

Water TD is a tower defense game where the enemy is a flood. Build turrets along the riverbanks and stop the water before it reaches your base.


Hundreds of thousands of drops pour toward your base.



Every turret has two builds that change how it fights.



Water eats into the riverbanks as it flows. Channels get wider, islands shrink, and a turret on a crumbling bank goes down with it.



Every level is a new map with its own flood to hold back.



When the line starts to break, throw a fireball, raise a wall of ice, call down lightning, or send the whole flood back the way it came.



Every level earns you points. Spend them on over 170 upgrades: unlock new turrets and abilities, make them stronger, and pick a build for each one.

item.title: How They Built the Pyramids
item.description:
Title: How They Built the Pyramids
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Pattez Games
Publisher: Pattez Games
Release Date: Nov 13, 2026




About This Game

There are plenty of theories about how the pyramids were built.

You and your friends have one too. It involves 23,426 bricks, a lot of hard work and probably a few questionable decisions.

How They Built the Pyramids is an online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Start by making bricks from Nile clay, then work together to build a 65-metre pyramid, one block at a time.

It's a lot of work. Luckily, you don't have to do it all by hand.

MAKE BRICKS. LOTS OF THEM.

It all starts with a bit of mud. Turn raw clay into bricks, improve their quality and find ways to make the whole process faster. You'll be making a lot of them.

GET THEM UP THERE

Carry bricks, toss them to your friends or find your own way of getting them to the top. Just make sure you're not standing underneath when something comes crashing down.

MANY HANDS MAKE LIGHT WORK

Bring your friends along, split up the work and get a proper operation going. Still need more hands? Hire some Shabti to help out. Just remember to keep them happy.

BUILD YOUR EMPIRE

What starts as a few people carrying bricks eventually becomes something much bigger. Build, connect and automate your production. Let the machines do the heavy lifting while you focus on getting that pyramid finished.

THERE ARE EASIER WAYS. BUT WHERE'S THE FUN?

Launch your friends across the pyramid. Send bricks flying through the air. Experiment with some rather unconventional construction methods. There is more than one way to get a brick where it needs to go.

ONE VERY BIG PYRAMID

26 layers. 65 metres tall. 23,426 blocks.

Finish the pyramid together, then keep building. Raise monuments, earn blessings and see just how far your little operation can go.

FEATURES

  • 1–8 player online co-op. Build together, divide the work or get in each other's way.

  • 23,426 blocks to place. One giant pyramid, built by your crew.

  • Build and automate. Turn a small brick-making operation into a fully running production line.

  • Get some help. Recruit little workers to take care of the less exciting jobs.

  • Find creative solutions. Carry, toss, launch and transport bricks in all sorts of ways.

  • Grow stronger. Improve your abilities and carry more as your operation grows.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i3 3.0 GHz or Ryzen 3xxx
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 960
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
